slides.subline: A developer I met last month. Every update came from WhatsApp messages to the site engineer. Most developers work exactly this way.

cards.label: Updates live in a chat
cards.desc: Every site instruction sits in a thread nobody can search.

cards.label: Context leaves with people
cards.desc: A project manager quits and three months of context goes with them.

cards.label: Every project starts over
cards.desc: The same mistakes, repeated, at full cost.

slides.subline: The same is true inside a company. If the standard only lives in someone's head, it is not a standard. It is a habit.

slides.kicker: WHAT A DESIGNED DECISION LOOKS LIKE
slides.headline: One project.|Three **numbers**.
